svg.title: Six-level taxonomy of urban agent capabilities
svg.desc: Six capability levels, their reasoning demands, and all 24 source-defined coverage categories. Schematics represent task requirements, not empirical results.

text.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
